title: Show account + project identity clearly in Bridge UI
description: Light UI task. First sync src/components/IdentityBanner.tsx and src/main.tsx exactly from GitHub main into the AI Studio workspace. Then make ONLY simple visible-copy cleanup in src/components/MissionControlView.tsx: replace technical operator-facing wording with plain Vietnamese where safe, including 'MẤT HEARTBEAT' -> 'MẤT TÍN HIỆU', 'REPOSITORY' -> 'PROJECT / KHO MÃ', 'AI TEAM' -> 'TÀI KHOẢN & AI ĐANG DÙNG', and avoid showing Bridge request/test counters prominently on the main screen (move/hide them rather than deleting metrics). Do not change workflow logic, API contracts, database, package.json, or server.ts. The new IdentityBanner must show project name, GitHub repo, branch, current app host, ChatGPT identity, and Google AI Studio identity. Bridge cannot safely auto-read login emails; preserve the banner's one-time local-device email labels and do not guess or hardcode any email. Run npm run lint and npm run build, restart Preview, verify /health status ok, visually inspect mobile layout, then submit any MissionControlView.tsx copy-only change through Studio Relay as a conflict-safe artifact for ChatGPT review. Do not publish yet.
